name: webelieve
caption:
WE BELIEVE 🎮🏀 Dallas won 67 games. We snuck in at 42-40. Then we sent them home.

• 2007: we close the season 16-5 to grab the 8 seed
• Our first playoffs since 1994
• We beat MVP Dirk Nowitzki's 67-15 Mavericks 4-2
• First 8 seed ever to beat a 1 seed in a 7-game series
• 19 years later, we started this season 7-3

Biggest upset in NBA history? 👇

beats.head: WE BELIEVE
beats.name: 8 SEED
beats.vo: Dallas wins sixty-seven games. We sneak into the playoffs at forty-two and forty. Nobody gives us a chance.
beats.dlg: DALLAS WON 67 GAMES.|WE SNUCK IN AT 42-40.

beats.head: THE RUN IN
beats.name: 8 SEED
beats.vo: We close the season sixteen and five. Our first playoff trip since nineteen ninety-four.

beats.head: THE UPSET
beats.name: MAVS
beats.vo: Against Dirk Nowitzki, the MVP, we win the series four games to two.
beats.dlg: WE BEAT MVP DIRK'S MAVS|4 GAMES TO 2!

beats.head: HISTORY
beats.name: WE BELIEVE
beats.vo: The first eight seed ever to knock out a one seed in a seven-game series.
beats.dlg: FIRST 8 SEED TO BEAT A 1|IN A 7-GAME SERIES.

beats.head: THIS YEAR
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Nineteen years later, we started this season seven and three. Nobody has to sneak in this time.

beats.head: BIGGEST UPSET?
beats.vo: Biggest upset in NBA history? Comment below.

facts.claim: 2006–07 (2007 playoffs): Warriors finished 42–40 after a 16–5 run, 8th seed, first playoffs since 1994; Dallas 67–15 with MVP Dirk Nowitzki; Warriors won 4–2, the first 8 seed to beat a 1 seed in a 7-game series; 2007 to 2026 is 19 years
